about: North Grenville is a municipality in the United Counties of Leeds and Grenville, Ontario, south of Ottawa toward Kemptville and the Rideau corridor. A growing town centre at Kemptville sits among farmland rather than a continuous urban sprawl. Highways 416 and 43 link into the capital region. About 18,000 people live in North Grenville.
seoSummary: Leeds–Grenville municipality centred on Kemptville—growing Rideau-corridor town and farmland south of Ottawa.
